findings.claim: The state part had no ticket building it. depends_on now names review-due and handoffs-list, both plans expose a function the briefing calls, and state is defined as counts plus the newest handoff's title.

Routing size was assumed with a 41-word margin. The plan now allows 200 words for routing (2.5 times the spike's guess) under a 600-word budget a test enforces. I3 sets no number, so 600 is the plan's to choose, and an overrun means tighter wording, not a different command shape.

The plan gives two budgets. Intent says 600 words with 339 + 200 + 40 (about 20 spare). The risk section still settles the risk as 'about 459 words, inside a 500-word budget', using the spike's 80-word routing guess. The budget is the number the test enforces, so a builder who takes 500 gets a test that fails on the plan's own 579-word allocation. Make the risk section's settlement match the 600-word budget and the 200/40 split.
